wins.text: Record AUM of $11.6 trillion; 6% organic base fee growth above the 5% through-the-cycle target, best start of year since 2021
Q1 revenue of $5.3B up 12% YoY; operating income up 14%; EPS of $11.30 up 15% YoY
ETF net inflows of $107B in Q1, annualizing ~10% above the record $390B full-year 2024; European ETF platform crossed $1T AUM with ~40% market share
Technology ACV grew 30% YoY (14% organically); Preqin added ~$20M to Q1 revenue and triples desktop reach to 300,000+ users
As-adjusted operating margin of 43.2%, up 100 bps YoY; $375M in share repurchases in Q1 with commitment to at least $375M/quarter for remainder of 2025

risks.text: Institutional index net outflows of $46B concentrated in low-fee index equities drove headline net inflows down to $84B vs. $140B ex-episodic redemptions
Entering Q2 with base fees approximately 1% lower than Q1 due to market and FX headwinds in the second half of Q1
Sweeping U.S. tariff announcements and geopolitical uncertainty creating near-term macro headwinds; Larry Fink described tariff scope as beyond anything seen in 49 years of finance
Performance fees of $60M decreased YoY, primarily reflecting lower performance revenue from private markets and liquid alternatives
HPS acquisition still pending regulatory approval; targeted mid-2025 close carries execution risk and related transaction costs excluded from current guidance

guidance_items.detail: Mid- to high single-digit percentage increase in 2025 core G&A expense, consistent with January guidance and excluding HPS impact
At least $375M in share repurchases per quarter for the balance of 2025, consistent with January guidance
25% projected tax run rate for remainder of 2025
Low to mid-teens ACV organic growth target maintained over the long term
Private credit AUM expected to scale to ~$220B following HPS close, targeted mid-2025 subject to regulatory approval

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Risk of client assets or capital flows moving away from U.S.-domiciled managers due to geopolitical backlash against U.S. firms
Competitive ETF pricing response to Vanguard fee cuts and outlook for iShares fee rate
Pace and demand dynamics for private markets entering the 401(k)/DC retirement channel and whether DOL safe harbor is a prerequisite
